QK RMSNorm, RoPE and gate extraction

decode recurrent core and packed norm when supported

gated norm with output-projection input staging

regions.dataflow: fused residual-add/RMSNorm -> attention or GDN -> fused residual-add/RMSNorm -> MLP
legal_next_boundaries: producer epilogue with immediately following residual-add/RMSNorm when numerical order is preserved
illegal_or_dependency_blocked: cross-layer projection fusion across residual, normalization, attention/recurrent state, or MLP activation dependencies

decision.highest_value_legal_untried_rewrite: Fuse the GDN QKVZ and BA projections into one 8224x1024 BF16 projection, then screen end-to-end before attempting a custom persistent schedule.
decision.why: It is the only repeated projection pair not already fused that shares an identical input without an intervening mathematical dependency.
decision.numerical_contract: Preserve BF16 weights, FP32 accumulation behavior as exposed by the selected linear backend, tensor layout, recurrent-state update and greedy token IDs.
